text: I am selling a $10M luxury residential property in Gold Coast. Which prestige real estate agencies have the strongest track record for high-end home sales?

result.keyword: I am selling a $10M luxury residential property in Gold Coast. Which prestige real estate agencies have the strongest track record for high-end home sales?

items.markdown:
For a $10M property on the Gold Coast, top-tier local agencies with proven ultra-luxury track records include [Kollosche](http://www.kollosche.com.au/) in Broadbeach , renowned for high-end residential sales, and [Amir Prestige](https://www.amirprestige.com.au/) , which holds multiple multi-million dollar coastal records. Boutique specialists like [Lucy Cole Prestige](https://www.lucycole.com.au/) also focus extensively on luxury waterfront and beachfront estates.[[1]](https://www.amirprestige.com.au/)[[2]](https://www.google.com/searchviewer/10?svid=CAwSHRIbCgNwdnESFENnMHZaeTh4TVdacU1IUXdjRzV3GAo)[[3]](https://www.lucycole.com.au/)

### Leading Luxury Agencies

- **Kollosche** : Widely recognized as a dominant force in high-end coastal and acreage properties, consistently ranking among top national performers for premium transactions.[[1]](https://www.google.com/searchviewer/10?svid=CAwSHRIbCgNwdnESFENnMHZaeTh4TVdacU1IUXdjRzV3GAo)
- **Amir Prestige** : Noted for major record-breaking luxury sales along Hedges Avenue and Main River, specializing in high-net-worth buyer networks.[[1]](https://www.amirprestige.com.au/)
- **Lucy Cole Prestige** : A long-standing boutique agency providing tailored, discreet marketing campaigns specifically for high-end waterfront and penthouse residences.[[1]](https://www.lucycole.com.au/)
